result.one_liner: Grain is a meeting intelligence platform that automatically records, transcribes, and generates AI-powered notes and action items from calls and meetings.

evidence.quote: Grain supports three authentication methods including Personal Access Token (PAT). Grain supports HTTP Bearer authentication, with three token types accepted: OAuth2 access tokens, Personal Access Tokens, and Workspace Access Tokens.
Personal API access is available on Starter, Business, and Enterprise plans. Workspace API access is available on Business and Enterprise plans and requires admin access to generate.
The API endpoint is located at api.grain.com/_/public-api/ for accessing meeting data and intelligence notes.
Grain's official MCP server allows you to securely access your meetings, notes, transcripts, deals, and coaching scorecard data natively using Anthropic's Claude Integrations.
Personal API access is available on Starter, Business, and Enterprise plans. Workspace API access is available on Business and Enterprise plans.

result.notes: Grain provides official MCP integration which enables direct Claude integration. API requires paid subscription tier (Starter or higher for personal access, Business/Enterprise for workspace access). REST API available at api.grain.com/_/public-api/.
